mapper.insert: insert into learning_agent_session (user_id, title, scene, status, last_message_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId}, #{title}, #{scene}, '0', sysdate(), sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.select: select session_id, user_id, title, scene, status, last_message_time, create_time, update_time from learning_agent_session where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'

select session_id, user_id, title, scene, status, last_message_time, create_time, update_time from learning_agent_session where user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' order by last_message_time desc, session_id desc
mapper.update: update learning_agent_session set title = ifnull(#{title}, title), last_message_time = sysdate(), update_time = sysdate() where session_id = #{sessionId}
update learning_agent_session set status = '1', update_time = sysdate() where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
update learning_agent_session set title = #{title}, update_time = sysdate() where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
